content.text: ## Context

After the bridge-cluster-202605 fix family (jade-cabin-tithe + pump-pup-lime + mud-karma-burst + 487d-ce11 + dc75-9b69 + fb8e-9022) lands, the bridge will be substantially more robust at NOT silently dropping events. But drift between local tickets and Jira will still accumulate over time when:
- Bridge runs partially succeed (BRIDGE_ALERT-tracked but not cursor-blocking once mud-karma-burst is fixed)
- Operators make direct Jira-side changes that don't go through the bridge
- External integrations (Linear, etc.) introduce indirect drift
The reconciliation done manually 2026-05-14/2026-05-15 (this session) ran:
1. `acli jira workitem search --jql 'project = DIG AND statusCategory != Done' --paginate --json`
2. Walk every event JSON on the `tickets` orphan branch to build local-id -> jira_key mapping
3. Compute set differences and field-mismatch lists
4. Surface drift classes (local-closed-jira-open, jira-open-no-local, field mismatches)
This worked but was a manual ad-hoc invocation. The drift is invisible until someone explicitly looks.
## Goal
Schedule the same reconciliation as a recurring CI check (daily or hourly) that:
1. Emits a structured BRIDGE_ALERT (or equivalent) whenever any drift class is non-empty
2. Posts a summary comment on a designated "bridge health" ticket so trends are visible
3. Categorizes drift by class:
- `local_closed_jira_open` (outbound STATUS failure pattern — was jade-cabin-tithe)
- `local_deleted_jira_open` (outbound DELETE failure pattern — surfaces mud-karma-burst-class failures)
- `jira_open_no_local` (inbound miss — was pump-pup-lime)
- `local_open_jira_closed` (this currently doesn't happen, but worth detecting)
- `field_mismatch` (title/type/status divergence on tickets open in both)
4. Provides a `--auto-fix` mode that auto-transitions safe classes (e.g., local-closed → Jira-Done) and offers a dry-run report for the rest
## Done Definitions
- When complete, a new GH Actions workflow runs the reconciliation on a cron schedule.
- When complete, drift counts are emitted as workflow output that operators can dashboard.
- When complete, non-zero drift triggers a notification on a tracked health ticket.
- When complete, the manual reconciliation done in this session is no longer needed for routine operations.
## Out of scope
- Fixing the bridge bugs themselves (covered by the cluster)
- Linear/external integration drift (separate concern)
- UI/dashboard work (workflow output and ticket comments are enough for v1)
## Related
- Cluster: bridge-cluster-202605
- Meta-bug surfaced this session: upper-glare-folio (Phase E Step 4 doesn't require production-equivalent verification)
- Process bug surfaced this session: pent-bully-chick (CI re-review treats every cycle as cycle_number=1)
